method: Per-person public web search (WebSearch) on full name + 'BITS Pilani' + LinkedIn and on the exact LinkedIn slug from TeamInfo.json; LinkedIn result titles/snippets, plus GitHub profile company/bio fields (GitHub API) and other public pages clearly tied to the same person. Only companies tied to the person by exact LinkedIn slug, GitHub account, or name plus BITS Pilani/DVM context were kept. BITS Pilani, DVM, student clubs, fests, BITS research roles and open-source mentorship programs (GSoC, LFX) were excluded. Scope: batches 2022, 2021, 2020, 2019, 2018, 2017. LinkedIn pages were not fetched directly, so entries reflect what search snippets exposed and may be incomplete or out of date.
